criteria.text: Current develop/master and CI/deploy identities are recorded.
Every skipped backend and web test is counted and classified by an explicit structural reason; accidental skips are fixed and affected tests pass.
The canonical release acceptance passes without a no-tests false positive.
dev.ai.megacampus.ru passes public health plus representative read-only API and UI checks for the delivered develop SHA.
Remaining unavailable live checks are named precisely and are not misreported as passing.
